_comment: Reference ABI for the CURRENT save schema. Mirrors SaveData (Escape.Core) and the SaveEnvelope wrapper. v1 and v2 documents are migrated on load — never edit a released schema, add a migration instead (SaveMigrations.cs).

_fieldNotes.player.HasPose: v3. Authoritative: a pose is restored only when this is true, so a save at the world origin is a real pose rather than an absent one. MigrationV2ToV3 sets it from the old 'position is not zero' inference.
_fieldNotes.player.Yaw: v2. Player ROOT yaw in degrees.
_fieldNotes.player.Pitch: v2. Camera pitch in degrees. Lives on PlayerLook, not the root.
_fieldNotes.player.EulerRotation: v1 legacy. Read only by SaveMigrationV1ToV2; not written by the current schema.
_fieldNotes.lures: v2. Thrown-lure count, clamped to >= 0 by SaveValidator.
_fieldNotes.collectedLures: v2. Ids of lures picked up in the world.
_fieldNotes.endingId: Empty until a broadcast completes; SaveValidator drops it when broadcastCompleted is false.

_invariants: sceneId must be a known scene
broadcastCompleted implies broadcastStarted and completedObjectives contains broadcast_truth
